{{/* Modal Component - renders a modal dialog container Updated for Stratus Design System Parameters: - id (required): Modal container id (used for open/close JavaScript) - title (required): Modal heading text - size (optional): Modal size - "sm", "md", "lg", "xl" (default: "md") - titleColor (optional): Title color class (default: "text-cool-grey-900") - zIndex (optional): z-index value (default: "50") - class (optional): Additional CSS classes Note: Modal content should be provided by the calling template. This component outputs the modal wrapper and header - content follows after. Close the modal div in your template after adding content. Usage: {{template "vendor/partials/modal.html" (dict "id" "createOrgModal" "title" "Create Organization" "size" "lg")}}
JavaScript helpers (add to your template): function openMyModal() { document.getElementById('myModal').classList.remove('hidden'); } function closeMyModal() { document.getElementById('myModal').classList.add('hidden'); } */}} {{/* Set defaults */}} {{$size := default .size "md"}} {{$zIndex := default .zIndex "50"}} {{$titleColor := default .titleColor "text-cool-grey-900"}} {{/* Size classes */}} {{$sizeClass := "max-w-lg"}} {{if eq $size "sm"}} {{$sizeClass = "max-w-sm"}} {{else if eq $size "lg"}} {{$sizeClass = "max-w-2xl"}} {{else if eq $size "xl"}} {{$sizeClass = "max-w-4xl"}} {{end}} {{/* Modal overlay - Stratus uses dark-grey for overlay */}}
